reason: Heating charcoal may produce ash for making soap, which could help equip the washstand.
expectation: I expect ash or another ingredient useful for soap, though I'm not certain.

alternatives.reason: Water might also extract something useful from charcoal, but heating seems a more direct way to get ash.

effect: The ash confirms the expected first ingredient; I can now mix it with water.
reaction: The result was predictable and useful.
reason: Ash and water may make an alkaline solution useful for soap.
expectation: I expect an ash-water solution, possibly lye, though I am unsure how the game represents it.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water might also produce something useful, but ash seems more directly connected to soap.

effect: The ash and water produced lye, giving me an ingredient to combine with the oil.
reason: Lye and oil are used to make soap, which should help equip the washstand.
expectation: I expect the combination to produce soap.

effect: The lye and oil made soap, so I can equip the washstand.
reaction: The explanation of how washing removes dirt and germs was useful.
reason: Adding soap to the washstand directly addresses the goal.
expectation: I expect a washstand equipped with soap and completion of the current goal.

effect: The washstand became a wash station, completing the goal and connecting handwashing with the separate drinking-water supply.
reaction: The finished station brought the earlier drainage work together with the new soap.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making soap was the most worthwhile step: the combination was understandable, and its explanation connected the material to removing dirt and germs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making ash was predictable and offered little to consider beyond following the soap-making sequence.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the ash, lye and soap followed the sequence I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; each chosen combination had an understandable role in making soap or equipping the washstand.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the settlement develops, though this chapter's choices were mostly predictable.
